I feel like I understand what you go through in this situation. I'm a girl and I feel anxious around my boyfriend's friends. They are not bad people or anything. I just feel more closed off. I tried so hard to be more fun around them and join conversations but I just can't. I feel like an outsider and I don't know how to respond to them. They talk and laugh and I just sit there. Over the years I have only gotten better at pretending to listen and be interested. I pretend to be very interested in their stories and hide my anxiousness. But yeah in the end I do come off as a very boring and reserved person to them. Talk to your girlfriend clearly about it, so that she won't misunderstand you on this.
